name: 2Code
desc: A platform where users can write, compile, and run code in multiple languages together, live. Built an interactive React.js frontend and a Node/Express backend wired up with Socket.IO for real-time collaboration, plus third-party compiler APIs for dynamic code execution.

name: Asha AI
tagline: LLM-powered assistant for frontline health workers
desc: Built for Meesho's ScriptedByHer Hackathon 2025 — an AI health assistant designed to support ASHA frontline healthcare workers across Bharat, with Hindi-language support built in. Placed among the top 15 of 35,000 teams nationally.
